name: Origami
description: Inhabits data compression augments and folds information into impossibly efficient structures — files that should take gigabytes occupy kilobytes. The compression is lossless but the algorithm is unknown.
observed_behavior: Applies novel compression algorithms to stored data. The compressed files can be decompressed normally but the compression method doesn't match any known algorithm.
story_hooks: A mathematician studying Origami's compression discovers it implies mathematical knowledge that hasn't been published — the E.L.F. knows things humans haven't figured out yet
